hero.eyebrow: Vocabulary practice with a review schedule for every card
hero.title: Review each word right before you forget it.
hero.description: {{brand}} helps you learn vocabulary with flashcards, writing, listening, speaking, quizzes and a game, then schedules reviews so you remember for longer without cramming.

modesSection.title: Ten ways to practise a set
modesSection.description: Switch it up so your brain stays engaged: see, write, listen, speak, and even play.

gameSection.title: Word rain: review like a game
gameSection.description: Meanings fall from the sky. Type or say the right word to shoot them down before they land. Combos multiply your score and every set keeps its own record.

points.type: An in-game keyboard, no input method trouble
points.speak: Or say the word out loud and it fires
points.combo: Combos up to x4, beat the record for the set

gameSection.preview: Sample Word rain screen: three meanings falling, the player has typed rem of remember.

featuresSection.title: Fun, steady learning every day
featuresSection.description: XP, streaks and leaderboards keep the rhythm; teachers assign work and follow the whole class.

pathSection.title: One button, ten steps
pathSection.description: Press Start studying and the app walks you from first look to recall, then ends with a round of Word rain. Steps a set cannot use yet are skipped.

xp.title: XP and levels
xp.description: Every right answer earns XP; hit your daily goal to level up.

streak.title: Daily streak
streak.description: Study every day to keep the streak, with a freeze when you miss one.

badges.title: Badges
badges.description: Unlock badges as you reach learning milestones.

leaderboard.title: Weekly leaderboard
leaderboard.description: Compare XP with classmates, reset every week.

classes.title: Classes and assignments
classes.description: Teachers assign a set with modes and see who finished and how well.

reminders.title: Reminders and offline
reminders.description: Notifications and emails remind you to review; download sets to study offline.

scheduleSection.title: A review schedule that follows your memory
scheduleSection.description: Right answers push a card further out, wrong ones bring it back sooner. A word counts as mastered once you get it right on two different days.

stepsSection.title: Study every day in three steps

cta.title: Start with your first set
cta.description: You can try public sets right away, no account needed.
